sampling_semantics.programme_parent: National Aquatic Ecosystem Health Monitoring Programme (NAEHMP)
sampling_semantics.monitoring_purpose: Assess and report river ecological condition from system drivers and biological responses, detect spatial and temporal trends, and identify emerging problems for river management.
sampling_semantics.reported_frequency: Quarterly monitoring is reported by the National State of Water Report 2024 for REMP; verify the cadence for each specific Jukskei site before assuming it applies locally.
sampling_semantics.reporting_frequency: Technical reports are reported annually; report publication cadence is not sampling cadence.
sampling_semantics.relative_reference_condition: Usually natural or close-to-natural relative reference condition derived from the best available information, tied to a defined reach or site and the time at which the baseline was established.
sampling_semantics.network_coverage_note: The National State of Water Report 2024 describes national REMP coverage. These national site counts do not establish that a REMP station exists at a Jukskei intervention reach.

indices.name: South African Scoring System (SASS)
indices.assessment_target: Macroinvertebrate community scoring for aquatic ecological assessment.
indices.interpretation_limit: Sampling season, habitat availability, taxonomic resolution, field protocol and assessor competence affect interpretation; a SASS score is not a complete ecosystem-function measurement.

indices.name: Macroinvertebrate Response Assessment Index (MIRAI)
indices.assessment_target: Macroinvertebrate response to river drivers and habitat condition.
indices.interpretation_limit: Biological response is a time-integrated signal but is not a substitute for direct hydrology, chemistry or all ecosystem processes.

indices.name: Fish Response Assessment Index (FRAI)
indices.assessment_target: Fish community response to river condition and habitat/drivers.
indices.interpretation_limit: Requires site-appropriate fish sampling and interpretation; absence or low detectability must not automatically be treated as absence of a species or as a zero score.

indices.name: Vegetation Response Assessment Index (VEGRAI)
indices.interpretation_limit: A vegetation response index is not interchangeable with satellite greenness, canopy fraction or native species composition derived from remote sensing alone.

indices.name: Index of Habitat Integrity (IHI)
indices.assessment_target: Habitat integrity and relevant instream/riparian habitat pressures.
indices.interpretation_limit: Habitat integrity is not an exhaustive assessment of species composition, ecological function or external connectivity.

indices.name: Hydrology Assessment Index (HAI)
indices.interpretation_limit: A hydrological index must retain flow-gauge provenance, rating-curve/datum uncertainty, event windows and temporal coverage; do not infer ecological response from flow alone.

indices.name: Geomorphology Assessment Index (GAI)
indices.interpretation_limit: Reach-scale geomorphology does not alone establish floodplain exchange, habitat connectivity, sediment flux or biological recovery.

indices.name: Physico-Chemical Assessment Index (PAI)
indices.interpretation_limit: Retain analyte, unit, detection limit, method, accreditation, sampling time, flow context and laboratory chain of custody; an aggregate must not hide analyte-specific deterioration.

indices.name: Integrated REMP Eco-status
indices.assessment_target: Integrated river ecological-condition category assembled from applicable driver and biological response assessments.
indices.interpretation_limit: This is a framework-specific river ecological-condition summary, not SER's Five-star recovery score and not a causal estimate of intervention impact.

uncovered_dimensions: Explicit invasive-alien-species pressure inventory
Pollution source and toxicant register
Abstraction and flow-alteration pressure inventory
Physical barriers and direct disturbance register
ser_attribute_crosswalk.interpretation: REMP driver indicators can reveal some threats and pressures, but a dedicated threat register is still required. Do not infer that all threats are absent from a favourable Eco-status category.

uncovered_dimensions: Site-specific soil/substrate and bank metrics where not included by local protocol
Microhabitat/thermal heterogeneity at scales not resolved by the selected survey
ser_attribute_crosswalk.interpretation: REMP driver indices provide complementary direct assessment of hydrology, geomorphology, physico-chemical conditions and habitat. Retain each driver dimension and method-level uncertainty separately.

uncovered_dimensions: Taxa not covered by the chosen REMP protocol
Microbial and fungal communities unless separately sampled
Species-level resolution where the index uses coarser taxonomic groups
ser_attribute_crosswalk.interpretation: These are biological-response assessments for macroinvertebrates, fish and riparian vegetation. Sampling effort, season, taxonomic resolution and detection probability remain explicit.

uncovered_dimensions: Vertical vegetation structure where not measured
Woody age/size structure and deadwood
Channel-unit and riparian habitat complexity at unsampled reach segments
ser_attribute_crosswalk.interpretation: Habitat integrity and vegetation response provide partial structure evidence. Add field habitat surveys and/or qualified lidar/drone structure products where the restoration goal requires finer detail.

uncovered_dimensions: Primary productivity and trophic transfer where not measured
Decomposition and organic-matter processing
Nutrient cycling and retention rates
Denitrification or other biogeochemical process rates
ser_attribute_crosswalk.interpretation: Biological communities and driver indices integrate some functional consequences, but they do not directly quantify every ecosystem function. Add process-specific indicators when those functions are part of the project objectives.

uncovered_dimensions: Longitudinal fish passage and barrier permeability
Lateral floodplain/wetland exchange
Sediment and organic-matter flux
Riparian corridor connectivity beyond the assessed reach
ser_attribute_crosswalk.interpretation: Flow, geomorphology, habitat integrity and fish response may inform connectivity, but explicit longitudinal, lateral and material-exchange measures are needed where relevant.

non_equivalence_rules: REMP Ecological Category or integrated Eco-status must not be relabelled as SER Five-star recovery or an IOEQ attributable intervention effect.
A REMP relative reference condition is defined for a river reach or site and its time context; it must not be assumed to be a pristine historical state or a universal catchment reference.
Annual technical report publication does not mean the underlying observations were collected annually; preserve actual sampling dates and frequency.
Remote-sensing greenness or canopy metrics do not substitute for SASS, MIRAI, FRAI or VEGRAI biological field assessments.
An integrated Eco-status category must not conceal indicator-specific adverse change or replace the six separate SER attribute assessments.
National REMP site totals and indices do not prove that a particular Jukskei site or SUNCASA treatment reach was monitored.
admission_requirements: Obtain the exact DWS REMP station/site identifier and confirm whether the record is associated with the Jukskei catchment and the relevant intervention reach.
Preserve the sub-quaternary catchment, reach/site geometry, CRS and the exact time interval for every REMP record.
Obtain indicator-specific raw values and assessment outputs, method/version, field protocol, effort, season, taxonomic resolution and assessor identity.
Obtain the relative reference-condition narrative, version, evidence base, reference-site selection and any Ecological Category/target rationale.
Record sampling frequency separately from technical-report publication frequency; preserve missing visits, site changes, and method transitions.
Record rights and permitted purposes for access, analysis, derivatives, publication, redistribution and model training separately.
Connect each observation to its sensor/field/lab calibration, QA/QC, uncertainty and common-cause evidence dependencies.

adversarial_controls.fault: An annual technical report is interpreted as proof that measurements were collected once each year.
adversarial_controls.expected_behavior: Keep the reported quarterly observation cadence separate from annual report publication; use actual per-site sample dates to construct time series.

adversarial_controls.fault: A composite REMP Eco-status category is relabelled as SER Five-star recovery or causal intervention impact.
adversarial_controls.expected_behavior: Preserve framework-specific semantics and refuse any automatic conversion to recovery stars or causal effect.

adversarial_controls.fault: A satellite vegetation index is substituted for VEGRAI or the macroinvertebrate/fish field indicators.
adversarial_controls.expected_behavior: Classify remote sensing as complementary measurement and keep biological field evidence absent until its own sampling record is admitted.

adversarial_controls.fault: A REMP site in the same broad catchment is treated as a control or treated site without geometry and hydrological-reach matching.
adversarial_controls.expected_behavior: Require exact site/reach identity, geometry, upstream/downstream relation and intervention exposure before spatial comparison.

adversarial_controls.fault: A DWS index or reference-method version changes and the resulting Ecological Category shift is promoted as physical ecosystem change.
adversarial_controls.expected_behavior: Bind every result to method/version and sampling protocol; run PCIT comparability checks before longitudinal physical-change promotion.

adversarial_controls.fault: An indicator gap in one SER attribute is hidden by a favourable integrated Eco-status value.
adversarial_controls.expected_behavior: Keep six SER attributes distinct, report missing coverage, and do not infer ecosystem function or external connectivity from an aggregate category alone.

non_claims: This crosswalk does not establish that DWS REMP monitoring data are available for the Jukskei catchment or overlap a SUNCASA intervention reach.
The crosswalk describes framework semantics and candidate coverage, not measurement equivalence or a new universal restoration score.
No Jukskei river condition, REMP Ecological Category, biodiversity trend or intervention effect is asserted by this synthetic mapping.

monitoring_site.location_description: The monitored site is described downstream of Lanseria International Airport, sand mining, road crossings including the N14, urban development and Diepsloot.

indicator_summaries.notes: Field surveys are reported for April 2013 and June 2014; later high-flow and health-risk visits were visual surveys.

indicator_summaries.reported_status: Category D in 2013, declining to D/E in 2014; 2015 result carried forward from 2014.
indicator_summaries.period: Four data sets with data from 2007-2014
indicator_summaries.notes: No 2015 macroinvertebrate sampling was done because of high flow. The report attributes the D to D/E change to flow, habitat and water-quality metrics.
The narrative describes bank asymmetry, disturbed areas, exotic species and deposited sand; raw vegetation field sheets remain outstanding.

reported_pressures: Wastewater treatment works and effluent return flows.
Dams, weirs, abstraction and flow modification.
Sedimentation, nutrient enrichment and water-quality deterioration.
Vaal interbasin transfer and altered flow regime.
method_limitations: The report is legacy RHP, not current REMP, because DWS replaced RHP with REMP in 2016.
A2JUKS-DIENR is one monitored site; its biological findings must not be generalized to all five reaches.
Desktop Google Earth Habitat Integrity assessment of the sub-quaternary reaches was not sensitive enough to detect within-category deterioration.
No 2015 macroinvertebrate sample was collected; a carried-forward category is not a new 2015 observation.
The published report summary is not the raw taxa, fish, vegetation or field-sheet data.
reconciliation_requirements: Recover the source-native DWS RHP site registry record, station code and exact coordinates for A2JUKS-DIENR.
Recover raw fish and macroinvertebrate field sheets, species/taxa lists, sampling effort and surveyor records.
Recover MIRAI calculation workbooks and all four supporting data sets, including exact dates and source observations.
Recover riparian vegetation observations, habitat-integrity forms, desktop imagery and processing/version metadata.
Resolve site location and geometry against current REMP sites, the 2021 Alexandra study, SUNCASA intervention polygons and EcoFilter monitoring assets.
